# Deep nesting

1. First
   - Nested bullet with a fairly long line that will certainly need to wrap at any reasonable width
     - Deeper still
       - And deeper, which should keep indenting without ever overflowing
   - Back up one

     A loose paragraph inside a list item.

     ```js
     const inCodeInList = true;
     ```

2. Second

   > A quote inside a list item
   >
   > - with a list inside the quote
   >   - nested inside that

> A quote
>
> 1. containing an ordered list
> 2. with two items
>
> ```python
> def code_in_quote():
>     return "yes"
> ```
>
> | in | quote |
> |---|---|
> | a | b |
